<svg width="1024" height="768" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:svg="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

  <rect data-name="btn_CLEAR" stroke-width="2" stroke="#000000" fill="#455a64" ry="8" rx="8" height="56" width="200" y="610" x="440" id="svg_0020-03dde0"/>

  <text id="svg_0022-041bbe" xml:space="preserve" stroke-width="0" fill="#888888" text-anchor="start" font-weight="normal" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" y="640" x="40" >HMI holds a credential that can start the conveyor (risk R-14). Recorded, not fixed: S8 attacks it.</text>
